title: Matrix Addition
inputOutputContract: Input n followed by n*n entries of matrix A, then n*n entries of B, row-major. Output n rows of sums.

anyPattern: first[row * n + col] - second[row * n + col]

mistakes.hint1: Inspect the subtracts matrices behavior in addMatrices; the current algorithm is close, but one operation changes its result.
mistakes.hint2: Start by tracing T1 manually. Watch array indices / comparisons / loop boundaries / return values at each iteration or recursive return.
mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of addMatrices: Each output cell equals the corresponding cells of the two input matrices, using consistent row/column indices.
mistakes.hint4: Concentrate on the expression or branch that controls this mistake: `first[row * n + col] - second[row * n + col]`. What does it do on the failing input?
mistakes.hint5: Compare the intermediate state with the expected output of T1. The mistake is in subtracts matrices, not merely formatting.
mistakes.hint6: Adjust the faulty operation so that it follows this rule: Each output cell equals the corresponding cells of the two input matrices, using consistent row/column indices.
mistakes.hint7: A targeted correction is to replace `first[row * n + col] - second[row * n + col]` with `first[row * n + col] + second[row * n + col]` in addMatrices, then retest T1–T6.
